name: poke-workspace
description: Poke plugins for Vite, Webpack, Next.js, Astro and more bundlers.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @poke-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/vite build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/playground-vite dev
scripts.dev:panel: pnpm --filter @poke-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/vite build && pnpm --parallel --filter @poke-dev/core --filter @poke-dev/vite --filter @poke-dev/playground-panel-react dev
scripts.dev:nextjs: pnpm --filter @poke-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/nextjs build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/playground-nextjs dev
scripts.dev:nextjs:webpack: pnpm --filter @poke-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/nextjs build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/playground-nextjs dev:webpack
scripts.dev:astro: pnpm --filter @poke-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/vite build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/astro build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/playground-astro dev
scripts.dev:webpack: pnpm --filter @poke-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/webpack build && pnpm --parallel --filter @poke-dev/core --filter @poke-dev/webpack --filter @poke-dev/playground-webpack dev
scripts.dev:webpack:once: pnpm --filter @poke-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/webpack build && pnpm --filter @poke-dev/playground-webpack dev
scripts.clean: pnpm -r --filter=./packages/* clean && node -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('node_modules', { force: true, recursive: true })"
